tier_reason: Upgraded from C under the wave's GPU-kernel precedent (GPU named in place of a host CPU; flags fixed by a public CMakeLists.txt, as for blackwell-tensorcore-kernels and cuspfft): the public harness benchmark.cu, driven by benchmark.sh, times sgemm.cu and cublasSgemm in the same binary (-DCUBLAS=1) with 500 warm-up iterations, CUDA events and an L2 flush; the README states nvcc V12.6.85, g++ 13.3, CMake 3.28.3, driver 550.120 and the RTX 3090, and CMakeLists.txt fixes the build (CUDA_ARCHITECTURES 86, separable compilation, no extra -O flags). The README plots show sgemm.cu above cuBLAS at large sizes.

corrections.compiler_and_flags: nvcc V12.6.85 (CUDA Runtime 12.6, CUDA Driver 12.4), g++ 13.3, CMake 3.28.3; the build is fixed by CMakeLists.txt: CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=86, CUDA_SEPARABLE_COMPILATION ON, -DGPUCC=86 -DCUBLAS=0/1, no CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE and no explicit -O flags (the -O3 lines are commented out).
corrections.caveats: Numbers exist only as two plot images (assets/perf.png unlocked clocks, assets/perf_locked.png at 1395 MHz, both 350 W); values are read by eye. Margins are single-digit percent at large sizes (about 4-5% unlocked, about 6-7% locked near m=n=k=12800), and sgemm.cu is slower than cuBLAS at several small sizes (near m=n=k=1280 about 17,000 vs about 19,300 GFLOP/s unlocked). Square FP32 NN only, tuned for the RTX 3090 (GA102); other GPUs untested in the repo. The host CPU is not stated (immaterial for a device-bound GEMM; A rests on the GPU-kernel precedent). The last commit (2025-01-21) swapped m and n in the cublasSgemm calls; for the square sizes plotted this does not change the cuBLAS work. The 'up to 24% faster than cuBLAS on a 4090' figure from the HN title is not on the repo page (snippet only); the project page salykova.github.io/sgemm-gpu was not opened (blocked). The plots also show a 'Simon Boehm | tinyBLAS' kernel well below cuBLAS. Repo identity inferred from the HN title and README (HN thread not opened).

notes: Plot readings in claimed_speedup checked against assets/perf.png and perf_locked.png and match. Harness is sound (warm-up, CUDA events, L2 flush, mean of the second half of iterations, same binary for cuBLAS).
